Geographies Served Programs Leukaemia Project District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The GOS Leukaemia Project aids children undergoing treatment for Leukaemia and other blood disorders at Government Children’s Hospital, Chennai. With 1000 children from Tamil Nadu and Andhra Pradesh, mainly from low-income families, the project covers medicine, nutrition, diagnostics, and transport costs. Additionally, it provides treats, nutritional supplements, and essentials like bags and bed sheets monthly. The Sunshine Aftercare Centre offers free accommodation for children recovering from Bone Marrow Transplant, with counselling and skill-building activities for mothers. The project also improves hospital facilities and supports families holistically. Meals On Wheels Programme District Chennai State Tamil Nadu District Chennai States Tamil Nadu The Meals-on-Wheels project aims to address the nutritional, health, financial, and emotional needs of impoverished elderly individuals. Services include monthly provision of provisions and protein-rich supplements, along with clothing, bedding, medical coverage, and recreational outings. Free eye care screenings and cataract surgeries are also provided. Collaboration with HelpAge India has strengthened efforts over nearly three decades. The project operates a Day Care Centre providing shelter, meals, and activities for elders, while a Geriatric Health Centre offers medical care to around 300 patients regularly. Physiotherapy sessions and health education are also provided, with plans to resume recreational outings post-COVID-19. Milestones & Track Record From modest beginnings as a single room Home in 1950, Seva Samajam has grown hugely in stature and reputation as an organization devoted to the rehabilitation, education and empowerment of destitute children. --> --> Leadership Team Seetha Mutthiah Vice - President Binoy Joseph Vice - Chairperson Himani Datar Honorary Secretary Ganapathi Subramanian Honorary Treasurer M&E Internal, External Assessors No --> Political & Religious Declarations On Affiliation if any No On Deployment Bias if any No --> Registration Details PAN Card AAAAG0071A CSR Form 1 Not Available 80G AAAAG0071AF20214 12A AAAAG0071AE20214 FCRA 75900188 About Headquarters Chennai, Tamil Nadu Since 1923 Demographies Served Children Teachers --> Impact To date, Seva Samajam Children's Home has rehabilitated, educated and empowered more than 4000 destitute children. Vision and Mission The Home is committed to creating a place where children are supported by caring adults, their holistic development is prioritized, and each child feels loved.
